Blue Meridian has obtained certain rights pursuant to the agreements described in Exhibit C attached hereto and made a part hereof (the "Blue Meridian Easements"), for the purpose of developing a transmission line (the "Blue Meridian Project"). Blue Meridian has also more generally obtained the right of eminent domain pursuant to its status as a public utility certificated and regulated by the Franklin Public Utility Commission ("FPUC"), with authority to construct the Blue Meridian Project, a high voltage direct current transmission line on a particular route through certain counties in Franklin. The FPUC issued Blue Meridian a certificate of convenience and necessity (the "CCN") in Case No. 19-FPUC-731-RTE to develop the Blue Meridian Project. That CCN became effective on February 14, 2018 and remains effective today. The Blue Meridian Easements are granted to develop, permit, construct, reconstruct, repair, improve, alter, replace, operate, use, inspect, maintain and remove a transmission line, on the Property, which transmission line may include poles, towers and structures, such as wires and cables as Blue Meridian shall from time to time suspend therefrom, foundations, footings, attachments, anchors, ground connections, communication devices and other equipment, accessories, access roads and appurtenances, as Blue Meridian may deem necessary or desirable in connection therewith, together with installation, operation and maintenance of fiber optic cable and other equipment needed for the transmission of communications to or by third parties (collectively, the "Blue Meridian Facilities").
